findings.title: verifySafeHtml throws RuntimeException instead of MojoExecutionException on I/O failure
findings.body: When the English reference file cannot be read (line 79) or the file itself cannot be re-read (line 70), a raw RuntimeException is thrown. The calling method `verify()` only catches IOException and wraps it in MojoExecutionException. Since RuntimeException is not an IOException, it propagates uncaught through `verify()` and will surface as an unhandled exception in the Maven build rather than a clean MojoExecutionException with a descriptive message. This produces a less helpful error output (stack trace instead of a clear 'unable to read file' message) and is inconsistent with the error handling contract established by the `verify()` method signature.
